Warnings array is empty even for malformed HTML (parser is lenient)

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Unclosed paragraph<div>Mixed nesting</p></div>')
puts result.content.inspect
puts result.warnings.inspect
```
